integrity: All cited code and recorded outputs are embedded in this package and were run for the present claim; bibliographic priority is assessed against listed accessible research records and primary sources, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The sharp six-vertex uniqueness claim is an exact finite census of all nontrivial trees up to six vertices, performed by a supplied self-contained Prüfer and minimax checker; the arbitrary-order one-vertex family is proven by explicit game strategies. No universal predomination-gap bound or ordinary tree-equality theorem is asserted.
title: A sharp tree obstruction to continuation in the indicated total domination game
